question: Does the actual public source include independently authenticated randomized or controlled intervention assignments and their observed effects, sufficient to distinguish at least the two LCRM01-A witness SCMs without future-label leakage?
supported_claim: Only a bounded two-SCM source-free identifiability witness; not arbitrary SCM identification or empirical learned transfer
required_independent_verification: externally pinned exact public original artifact digest from trusted independent authority, not a digest supplied by the purported artifact itself
authenticated issuer and original run/sequence identity tied to repository/source birth
explicit do-target and do-value assignment with baseline and observed outcome at a known intervention point
documented mechanism or design to justify action exogeneity or paired counterfactual stability; do not infer from event field
intervention outcome must be public and available to all arms on the same FIT boundary, not protected CHECK or heldout
natural abstention on non-discriminating interventions and observational equivalence
fully trained symbolic version-space and relational/recurrent peer controls see identical labels

synthetic_analytic_test_rules.expected_positive: a public, independently authenticated do X intervention with X flipped relative to known U distinguishes direct_chain and common_cause in a *two-SCM witness model class*
synthetic_analytic_test_rules.expected_negative: historical event schema, self-declared provenance, no independently pinned identity, reused witness, do X=U, no public outcome, changed baseline identity, tampered captured outcome, contradictory evidence

actions.allowed: read-only historic source inspection plus local source-only verifier and adversarial tests; commit new B2 source/negative evidence to existing DRAFT branch
actions.forbidden: source-born new cohort, protected scientific first-use, queue/dispatch, controller, paid API, main merge/promotion, workstation action

acceptance: No new scientific source is admitted unless exact authenticated intervention proof exists outside the model/source author. In absence of proof, return FAIL_CLOSED_NOT_AUTHENTICATED_DO, not success or an arbitrary deterministic claim.
